examples.en: I had an upset stomach, so I went to an internal medicine clinic.

examples.ko: 감기에 걸려서 회사 앞 내과에 갔어요.
examples.en: I caught a cold, so I went to the clinic in front of my office.
Which floor is internal medicine on? — The third floor.
The internal medicine doctor pressed on my stomach.

examples.ko: 내과 예약은 인터넷으로 할 수 있어요.
examples.en: You can book an internal medicine appointment online.

explain: 내과는 감기, 배탈, 열처럼 몸 안의 병을 보는 곳이에요. 다친 뼈는 정형외과, 피부는 피부과에 가요.
explain_en: 내과 treats illnesses inside the body, such as colds, stomach trouble and fever. For a broken bone go to 정형외과; for skin, 피부과.

examples.en: I climbed the stairs and was out of breath.
I get out of breath even if I run a little.

examples.ko: 산에 오를 때 숨이 차서 자주 쉬었어요.
examples.en: I was out of breath climbing the mountain, so I rested often.
If you're out of breath, sit down and rest for a moment.
I exercised after a long time and I'm quite out of breath.

explain: 붙여서 ‘숨차다’라고도 써요. 비슷한 말로 ‘숨이 가쁘다’가 있고, 숨을 크게 여러 번 쉬는 것은 ‘숨을 몰아쉬다’예요. 계단을 오르며 ‘아이고, 숨차’라고 말하는 어른이 많아요.
explain_en: It can also be written as one word, '숨차다'. A similar expression is '숨이 가쁘다', and taking deep, heavy breaths is '숨을 몰아쉬다'. Many older people say '아이고, 숨차' while climbing stairs.
